reason: Successfully tested agent messaging functionality: navigated to application, opened the QA-20261021-222252-6cs0 agent, sent a math question, and verified the agent correctly responded with the answer containing "4".
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Application loaded successfully with home page displaying two agents in sidebar.
Found "QA-20261021-222252-6cs0" agent in sidebar and clicked it — Successfully opened agent detail page; agent status showed as "idle".
Verified agent status is "running" or "idle" — Agent status was "idle" (ref=e200), which satisfies the requirement.
Sent message "Hello! What is 2+2?" — Message typed into input field and sent button clicked; message appeared in chat with timestamp "Today at 10:23 PM".
Waited up to 3 minutes for response — Activity indicator disappeared after approximately 10-15 seconds, indicating response was ready.

Verified response mentions "4" and took screenshot — Agent responded with "2 + 2 = 4." The response is clearly visible in the screenshot and contains the number "4" as expected. Session was renamed to "Simple Arithmetic Question" by the agent.
